title: Disabling and re-enabling of UE's N1 mode capability for non-3GPP access

entities.name: N1 mode capability for non-3GPP access
entities.description: UE capability to use N1 mode over non-3GPP access networks. Can be disabled or re-enabled based on conditions.

entities.name: IMS voice not available over non-3GPP access in 5GS
entities.description: Condition where IMS voice service is unavailable over non-3GPP access in 5GS, leading to disabling of N1 mode capability.

entities.name: Voice centric usage setting
entities.description: UE configuration prioritizing voice services, affecting N1 mode capability decisions.

entities.name: Data centric usage setting
entities.description: UE configuration prioritizing data services, triggering re-enabling of N1 mode capability.

entities.name: PLMN or SNPN selection over non-3GPP access
entities.description: Procedure where UE selects a new PLMN or SNPN over non-3GPP access, triggering re-enabling of N1 mode capability.

entities.name: No network slice available for camped PLMN/SNPN
entities.description: Condition where no network slice is available for the currently camped PLMN or SNPN, potentially leading to disabling of N1 mode capability.

entities.name: Timer for re-enabling N1 mode capability
entities.description: Optional timer started after disabling N1 mode capability; on expiry, UE should re-enable the capability.

entities.name: 5GS NAS procedures over non-3GPP access
entities.description: NAS procedures initiated by UE towards network over non-3GPP access.

relations.description: When N1 mode capability is disabled, UE shall not initiate NAS procedures over non-3GPP access.
Condition where IMS voice is unavailable leads to disabling of N1 mode capability.
Voice centric usage setting is required for IMS voice unavailability condition to trigger disabling.
Change to data centric usage setting triggers re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
New PLMN or SNPN selection over non-3GPP access triggers re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
Condition of no network slice available may lead to disabling of N1 mode capability.
Timer expiry triggers re-enabling of N1 mode capability.
